verdict.rationale: Kit's documented public API includes a create-a-broadcast endpoint that supports drafting or scheduling a send to all/subset of subscribers via segment or tag targeting, with OAuth/API key auth, pagination, and stats endpoints, all fully documented — enabling a developer to build and schedule campaigns without the dashboard. Missing for 10: no publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s) and no independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of the full create-and-schedule flow.
